title: Choice list
description: One choice among options laid out whole, each a line one presses — its icon, its name, a line saying more of it —, the one chosen marked. What a select would fold away, read before one is taken. What is done with the choice is the reader's application's: the list offers, it does not send.

value.description: What the choice is, as it is answered.

description.description: A line saying more of it.

group.description: The name of the run of options it belongs to.

value.description: The option chosen, when one is.

label.description: What names the list, for whoever reads it aloud.
